text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, everyone! Together with your 
Class Rep! Let's make this another 
fantastic group presentation!!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Objective: "Differences in Training by 
Aptitude Distance," and "Successful Group 
Presentation." Executing mission.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! First up, 'Long Distance'! What is 
the most important factor!? Rice-san!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Fue!? S-Stamina... maybe?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, so close! The correct answer is 
"Bakushin-like speed"!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: B-Bakushin-like speed...?!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. What Bakushin O-chan is trying to 
say is... to build up "stamina," you have 
to train a whole lot.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
In order to train as much as possible, we 
need to get through workouts quickly—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed!! That is the very essence of 
Bakushin!! Naturally, the same applies to 
all other distances!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Understood. I-I see...! Ohh! I see now!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Unexpected outing detected. Acquired 
status "Confused." Requesting presentation 
of objective.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I am so glad you asked! ...It's all for 
one thing! To make a truly Bakushin 
announcement!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: A B-Bakushin-like announcement...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! "The Bakushin is mightier than the 
sword!" With this, there's no doubt my 
presentation will be perfect!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! To make a presentation that 
can be understood at Bakushin speed, we 
definitely want actual training videos♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, I see, so that's it...! It really is 
boring just talking about it, isn't it. 
All right! Let's run based on the theory 
we just looked up!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
“—And so! No matter the training, the key 
point is, simply put: ‘Bakushin volume’!!”

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
By the way, "Bakushin amount" here refers 
to the "workload" in our training♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
In other words, even with the same 
training, if the "load" and "Bakushin 
amount" are higher...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Our stamina will BAKUSHIN!! And it'll 
become training suited for long distances! 
Mmm! What a Bakushin-esque discovery! 
Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Mission complete. Executing "celebration 
drink."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. That turned out to be a wonderful 
announcement. Thank you for taking the 
lead, Bakushin O-chan!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
This is nothing! I don't recall actually 
dancing, but as the class representative, 
I must prevail!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You were incredible too, Flight-san...! 
You kept correctly guessing everything 
Bakushin O-san was saying.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It just felt... kinda like magic, you 
know!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hehe♪ That's probably... because your 
opponent is Bakushin O-chan!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Because we run together a lot, so I get 
plenty of chances to see.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"‘Habits’... or perhaps one's innate 
‘aptitude.’"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to Bakushin O-chan, I'm 
pretty confident I know her better than 
anyone else... maybe♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
...I see!!! In other words, your 
understanding of Bakushin has bakushin-ed 
to new heights!! Is that it?! Splendid!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
As expected of "fellow runners on the same 
turf"! This is truly "Great Minds Bakushin 
Alike"...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While visiting the cafeteria for a break, 
I overheard an intriguing conversation and 
couldn't help but chime in.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! When you say "more"... what 
do you mean?
choice_data_list:
I wanna Bakushin my understanding of 
Flight!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And if we achieve 'Ishin-Bakushin' 
telepathy and I can provide even more 
precise support..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
...I see! In other words!! This is a 
challenge letter addressed to me, Bakushin 
O, isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Very well, very well! I accept your 
challenge! Now! Tell me what you've got in 
mind!
choice_data_list: A Bakushin-speed race to get work done!

I-I'll win with Bakushin-style fashion 
power!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: —Yes! It's done!
choice_data_list:
...Wait, the answer sheet is completely 
blank!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"'A contest of speed in getting work 
done'... We competed to see who could 
finish their homework and prep materials 
faster, but this is..."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O-chan. When you don't understand 
a question, don't just bakushin through 
it; let's do our best to solve it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the match was put on hold for now. 
Together with North Flight, I helped 
Sakura Bakushin O with her homework.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, I'd totally recommend this kind 
of fashion for you two♪”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I see!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It turned into a study session 
instead of a match, didn't it!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Silly me, I just couldn't help 
myself...♪
